sections.content: You know from B1 Unit 25 that the verb moves back one step after a past reporting verb, and you met *al día siguiente* there. When you retell a conversation from another place or time, the pronouns and the time and place words change too.

items.english: “I live here” → He said that he lived there.

items.spanish: «Mañana voy» → Dijo que al día siguiente iba.
items.english: “I am going tomorrow” → He said that he was going the next day.

items.spanish: «Estoy en mi habitación» → Dijo que estaba en su habitación.
items.english: “I am in my room” → He said that he was in his room.

sections.content: Everything moves one step into the past and away from “here”: *vivo* becomes *vivía*, *aquí* becomes *allí* and *mañana* becomes *al día siguiente*, as in *Dijo que vivía allí*.
